text:
The text contains clear sarcasm in the first two sentences. The speaker claims to "love" when their phone dies during an important call and calls it the "best feature of modern technology." Since phone battery failure during critical moments is universally frustrating and undesirable, the positive language is used ironically to express strong annoyance and frustration.

This sarcasm significantly shifts the sentiment polarity from positive to negative. While the literal words suggest positivity ("love," "best"), the intended meaning is highly negative, conveying irritation and dissatisfaction with the situation. The final sentence regarding the Amazon Rainforest is a neutral factual query and does not contribute to the sarcastic sentiment.
